```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("R/publication_artifacts.R"))
begin_artifact_render("table_4")
source(here::here("R/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03", "04", "05"),
  funs = c("model_fun", "calculate_outcomes", "cea_helpers", "report_format"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r build-table, include=FALSE}
basecase <- run_basecase(verbose = FALSE)
icer_df <- as.data.frame(basecase$icer_obj)

# Table 4: dampack efficiency-frontier results (the CEA.qmd convention, issue
# #153). Labels are looked up by name (issue #157).
display_df <- icer_df %>%
  filter(as.character(Strategy) %in% names(strategy_labels)) %>%
  mutate(
    Strategy_Label = strategy_label(Strategy),
    Cost = format_eur(Cost),
    QALYs = sprintf("%.2f", Effect),
    Inc_Cost = format_eur(Inc_Cost),
    Inc_QALYs = ifelse(is.na(Inc_Effect), "--", sprintf("%.2f", Inc_Effect)),
    ICER = mapply(format_icer, ICER, Status)
  ) %>%
  select(Strategy_Label, Cost, QALYs, Inc_Cost, Inc_QALYs, ICER)

# Table S5: full results at three decimals with, for every guided strategy,
# the PAIRWISE comparison against standard of care (increments, ICER and
# status from calculate_pairwise_icers()) alongside the frontier ICER and
# frontier status of Table 4 (issue #153 conventions). Before issue #157
# outputs/tables/table_s5.csv was a byte-identical copy of tables/table_4.csv.
table_s5_df <- calculate_pairwise_icers(basecase$base_results) %>%
  mutate(
    Frontier_ICER = icer_df$ICER[match(Strategy, as.character(icer_df$Strategy))]
  ) %>%
  select(Strategy, Cost, Effect, Inc_Cost, Inc_Effect, ICER, Status,
         Frontier_ICER, Frontier_Status)

display_df_s5 <- table_s5_df %>%
  transmute(
    Strategy = strategy_label(Strategy),
    Cost = format_eur(Cost),
    QALYs = sprintf("%.3f", Effect),
    Inc_Cost = ifelse(Status == "Reference", "--", format_eur(Inc_Cost)),
    Inc_QALYs = ifelse(Status == "Reference", "--", sprintf("%.3f", Inc_Effect)),
    Pairwise_ICER = format_icer(ICER, Status),
    Pairwise_Status = Status,
    Frontier_ICER = format_icer(Frontier_ICER, Frontier_Status),
    Frontier = frontier_label(Frontier_Status)
  )
```

## Table 4

```{r display-table-4}
kable(
  display_df,
  caption = "Table 4: Deterministic point evaluation at fitted parameters, anchoring the one-way sensitivity analysis",
  format = "html",
  col.names = c("Strategy", "Cost", "QALYs", "Incremental Cost",
                "Incremental QALYs", "ICER"),
  align = c("l", rep("r", 5))
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Costs and QALYs discounted at 4% per year.",
      paste0("All strategies use the same complete-case target population (n = ", nrow(l_params_base$prediction_population), ")."),
      "ICER = incremental cost-effectiveness ratio versus the next non-dominated alternative.",
      paste0("WTP threshold: EUR ", format(WTP, big.mark = ","), "/QALY.")
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

## Table S5

```{r display-table-s5}
kable(
  display_df_s5,
  caption = "Table S5: Deterministic point evaluation anchoring the one-way sensitivity analysis (pairwise versus standard of care and efficiency frontier)",
  format = "html",
  col.names = c("Strategy", "Cost", "QALYs", "Incremental Cost vs SoC",
                "Incremental QALYs vs SoC", "Pairwise ICER vs SoC",
                "Pairwise status", "Frontier ICER", "Frontier status"),
  align = c("l", rep("r", 5), "l", "r", "l")
) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
  footnote(
    general = c(
      "Increments and the pairwise ICER compare each guided strategy with standard of care (issue #153).",
      "Control and both guided strategies share the same complete-case population and joint biomarker distribution (issue #166).",
      "The frontier ICER is the dampack incremental ratio versus the next non-dominated alternative, as in Table 4; a strategy that is dominated on the frontier (more costly and less effective than the other guided strategy) can still have a finite pairwise ICER.",
      "Costs and QALYs discounted at 4% per year."
    ),
    general_title = "Notes: "
  )
```

```{r save-table, include=FALSE}
tables_dir <- here("outputs", "tables")
if (!dir.exists(tables_dir)) dir.create(tables_dir, recursive = TRUE)
write_artifact_csv(icer_df, file = here("outputs", "tables", "table_4.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write_artifact_csv(table_s5_df, file = here("outputs", "tables", "table_s5.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

Tables 4 and S5 have been saved to `outputs/tables/table_4.csv` (frontier results) and `outputs/tables/table_s5.csv` (pairwise-versus-SoC results with the frontier ICER and status).
